LoginUserSchema.title: Sign-in request
LoginUserSchema.description: Credentials for an existing account. New-password complexity rules are not applied during sign-in.

username.title: Username
username.description: 5–256 characters. Starts with a Latin letter; ends with a Latin letter or digit. Latin letters, digits and underscores are allowed. Normalized to lowercase.

password.title: Password
password.description: Existing password, 1–256 characters. Passed unchanged to hash verification, including spaces; case is significant.

RegisterUserSchema.title: Registration request
RegisterUserSchema.description: Creates an account awaiting confirmation. The password is chosen in the confirmation request.

username.title: Username
username.description: Unique username, 5–256 characters. Starts with a Latin letter, ends with a Latin letter or digit; only Latin letters, digits and underscores. Normalized to lowercase.

email.title: Email address
email.description: A valid unique email address. Stored in lowercase. The email validator also applies email-specific length limits.

RegisterUserResponse.title: Registration result
RegisterUserResponse.description: Identifier of the newly created user. Registration alone does not activate the account.

user_id.title: User ID
user_id.description: User UUID. This identifier is not a confirmation token.

ConfirmUserSchema.title: Registration confirmation request
ConfirmUserSchema.description: A one-time registration token and the password to set for the account.

token.title: Confirmation token
token.description: Opaque registration token, 1–512 characters without whitespace. Use the token from the confirmation flow, not the user UUID or an access token.

password.title: New password
password.description: 8–256 characters, with a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter, a digit and an ASCII punctuation character. The password is not trimmed.

RefreshSessionSchema.title: Session refresh request
RefreshSessionSchema.description: Exchanges the current refresh token for a replacement and a new access token.

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: The latest opaque refresh token issued for this session. 1–512 characters without whitespace. Single use for refresh.

LogoutUserSchema.title: Sign-out request
LogoutUserSchema.description: Identifies the session to revoke. Repeated requests are safe.

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: A refresh token belonging to the session, including a previously rotated token. 1–512 characters without whitespace.

TokenResponse.title: Token pair
TokenResponse.description: Tokens are returned in JSON. This implementation does not set authentication cookies. Example token strings are placeholders, not usable credentials.

access_token.title: Access token
access_token.description: Signed JWT with a limited lifetime. Do not use it as a refresh or confirmation token.

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Opaque secret bound to a session. After a successful refresh, replace the previous value with this token.

ErrorResponse.title: Expected API error
ErrorResponse.description: JSON envelope for expected HTTP, validation and business errors. Unexpected server failures remain HTTP 500 and do not use this schema.

detail.title: Error details
detail.description: A stable code, a human-readable message and optional validation issues.

ErrorDetail.title: Error details
ErrorDetail.description: Use code for programmatic handling. Changing documentation language does not translate actual API messages.

code.title: Error code
code.description: Machine-readable identifier such as invalid_credentials or invalid_refresh_token.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable explanation. Current API messages are in English.

errors.title: Validation issues
errors.description: Field-level issues when applicable; otherwise an empty array. Original passwords, tokens, input and validation context are not reflected.

ValidationIssue.title: Validation issue
ValidationIssue.description: Location and reason for a rejected request field.

loc.title: Location
loc.description: Path to the field, for example ["body", "password"]. Array indexes may be integers.

type.title: Issue type
type.description: Validation category such as missing, string_too_long or invalid_password.

ChangePasswordSchema.title: Password change request
ChangePasswordSchema.description: Current and new passwords for the authenticated user.

current_password.title: Current password
current_password.description: Current password, 8–256 characters; validated against the current complexity policy.

new_password.title: New password
new_password.description: 8–256 characters including lowercase, uppercase, a digit and ASCII punctuation.

RequestPasswordResetSchema.title: Reset request
RequestPasswordResetSchema.description: Requests an email for an active account with a password.

email.title: Email
email.description: Valid email, normalized to lowercase. Account existence is not disclosed.

ConfirmPasswordResetSchema.title: Reset confirmation request
ConfirmPasswordResetSchema.description: One-time reset token only. Extra fields are forbidden.

token.title: Reset token
token.description: Secret from the email, 1–512 characters without whitespace. Not a registration token or JWT.

PasswordResetRequestedResponse.title: Reset request accepted
PasswordResetRequestedResponse.description: Does not reveal whether an account exists or an email was queued.

message.title: Message
message.description: Identical message for every valid email address.

PasswordResetResponse.title: Generated password
PasswordResetResponse.description: Returned after transaction commit. Never cache or log this response.

password.title: Password
password.description: Generated password for the next sign-in. Shown once and never emailed.

UserResponse.title: User profile
UserResponse.description: Profile of the current active user. Password hashes and tokens are never returned.

id.title: User ID
id.description: User UUID identified by the verified access JWT.

email.title: Email
email.description: Current user email as a string.

created_at.title: Registration time
created_at.description: Account creation timestamp with a timezone.

SessionResponse.title: User session
SessionResponse.description: Metadata of your own session. An active session is not revoked and expires_at is strictly later than the current time.

id.title: Session ID
id.description: UUID used to revoke this session. This is not a refresh token.

expires_at.title: Expiry time
expires_at.description: Absolute expiry timestamp with a timezone.

created_at.title: Sign-in time
created_at.description: Session creation timestamp with a timezone.

ip_address.title: Sign-in IP
ip_address.description: Connection IP address when the session was created.

user_agent.title: Sign-in User-Agent
user_agent.description: Original User-Agent or null. This is client-controlled and does not prove device identity.

last_ip_address.title: Last IP
last_ip_address.description: IP of the latest successful refresh, or null if no refresh has occurred.

last_user_agent.title: Last User-Agent
last_user_agent.description: User-Agent from the latest successful refresh, or null.

last_used_at.title: Last activity
last_used_at.description: Timestamp of the latest successful refresh. Ordinary JWT-authenticated requests do not update this field.

CreateWalletSchema.title: Wallet creation request
CreateWalletSchema.description: Name and currency. The JWT selects the owner; the server creates the number and accounting records. Extra fields are forbidden.

name.title: Wallet name
name.description: Leading and trailing whitespace is removed; then 1–64 characters are required. Empty or whitespace-only names are forbidden.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Wallet currency; defaults to USD. Cannot be changed through this API after creation.

RenameWalletSchema.title: Wallet rename request
RenameWalletSchema.description: Only a new name is accepted. Owner, currency, status and balance cannot be changed.

name.title: Wallet name
name.description: Leading and trailing whitespace is removed; then 1–64 characters are required. Empty or whitespace-only names are forbidden.

CreateWalletResponse.title: Wallet creation result
CreateWalletResponse.description: Returned after successful commit. The initial balance is zero.

wallet_id.title: Wallet ID
wallet_id.description: Created wallet UUID. This is not the 20-digit wallet number.

CurrencyEnum.title: Currency
CurrencyEnum.description: Supported currency codes: USD, EUR, JPY, CHF, GBP, UZS, CAD, RUB.

WalletResponse.title: Wallet with balance
WalletResponse.description: Read model of your own wallet. Balance is read through a JOIN with wallet_balances.

user_id.title: Owner ID
user_id.description: Owner UUID matching the user identified by the JWT.

balance_minor.title: Balance
balance_minor.description: Nonnegative integer in currency minor units, serialized as a decimal string to preserve JavaScript precision. A missing balance record is not replaced with zero.

number.title: Number
number.description: 20 ASCII digits as a string. Leading zeroes are preserved.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency of the wallet and its balance.

status.title: Status
status.description: active, frozen or closed. Reading your own closed wallet is allowed.

updated_at.title: Update time
updated_at.description: Wallet metadata update time. Changing only the balance does not update this field.

WalletStatusEnum.title: Wallet status
WalletStatusEnum.description: Valid wallet statuses: active, closed, frozen.

WalletSortEnum.title: Wallet sorting
WalletSortEnum.description: Supported fields: name, currency, balance, created_at, status. Directions: asc and desc. Format: field:direction.
